annotations.title: Zodiac sign from a birth date: western and Chinese

description: Western (tropical) zodiac sign with its element, and the Chinese zodiac animal and element of a birth date. The Chinese year is counted from the Gregorian year, so dates in January and early February before Chinese New Year are flagged as possibly the previous animal. Use for profile enrichment, greeting cards, games or horoscope-style content. Example: date=1990-08-15. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
